TEAM_MONITORING.DESCRIPTION: Who is handling which conversations right now, and how each team is performing.
TEAM_MONITORING.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the monitoring data. Try refreshing.
TEAM_MONITORING.EMPTY: No team to show yet. Create a team and assign a supervisor to it.
TEAM_MONITORING.EMPTY_TEAM: This team has no members yet.
TEAM_MONITORING.FOOTNOTE: Figures are counted per agent: an agent who belongs to several teams is counted in each of them, so team totals do not add up to the account total.
